note: Both sets attempt to extract numerical coordinates from the scatter plot, which is highly error-prone. Set A correctly estimates the x2 coordinate of the Geometric Center (-0.25 m) and the x3 coordinate of the Neutral Axes (~0.02 m), though it also includes several incorrect estimates. Set B's coordinate estimates are almost entirely incorrect (e.g., placing the Mass Center at x3=0.0 m and Geometric Center at x2=-0.2 m). Set A is slightly better due to having fewer incorrect plot readings.
